title: Nvidia board says it is "in the process of selecting a search firm" for the CEO role and it has "not formally engaged any potential candidates" (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Nvidia board says it is “in the process of selecting a search firm” for the CEO role and it has “not formally engaged any potential candidates” — Nvidia hasn't yet selected a search firm to work with in identifying a successor for former CEO Jensen Huang, the company's board told CNBC.
contentText:
CNBC :

Nvidia board says it is “in the process of selecting a search firm” for the CEO role and it has “not formally engaged any potential candidates”   —  Nvidia hasn't yet selected a search firm to work with in identifying a successor for former CEO Jensen Huang, the company's board told CNBC.
